question:
Let $\vec{a} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 3\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b} = -\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$. A point R divides the line segment joining points A and B (with position vectors $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$) externally in the ratio 2:1. Find:

(a) The position vector of R,

(b) The magnitude of vector $\vec{AR}$,

(c) Verify whether vector $\vec{AR}$ is perpendicular to $\vec{AB}$.
